opportunities.name: Country macro snapshot: World Bank lookup, Wikipedia check, draft email
opportunities.description: For a given country, look up its indicators on World Bank Open Data, look it up on Wikipedia, then draft an email to a recipient with a 'macro snapshot' summary (GDP, growth, population, capital, currency) and discard the draft.
steps: Open World Bank Open Data home and type the country in the search box, press Enter
Read GDP/population and other indicators from the country page
Open Wikipedia and search the country, press Enter, read capital and currency
Open mail New message and fill To with the recipient email
Fill Body with 'Hi <name>, <Country>: GDP ..., growth ..., population ...; capital ..., currency ...'

instances.values: Kenya, olivia@example.com, GDP US$135.94B, growth 4.6%, pop 57,532,493, Nairobi, KES
Vietnam, raj@example.com, GDP US$514.7B, growth 8.0%, pop 101,598,527, Hanoi, VND
Chile, sofia@example.com, GDP US$357.37B, growth 2.5%, pop 19,859,921, Santiago, CLP

opportunities.name: Book reading log: Gutenberg search, author lookup on Wikipedia, add note
opportunities.description: Search a book title on Project Gutenberg, open the top result, look up the author on Wikipedia, then add a note 'Read: <title> by <author> (years), Gutenberg since <date>, <downloads> downloads'.
steps: Type the book title in Gutenberg quick search and press Enter
Click the top result and read author, release date and downloads
Search the author on Wikipedia and read life years
Type 'Read: <title> by <author> (<years>), Gutenberg since <release date>, <downloads> downloads' and press Enter

instances.values: Pride and Prejudice, Jane Austen, 192356 downloads
The Count of Monte Cristo, Alexandre Dumas, 53017 downloads
